rationale: The phone app requires a warm, classical, dignified parchment aesthetic suitable for reading sacred text (Organic & Earthy). The projector route requires an inverted, pure black background (high-contrast dark mode) to successfully map ONLY the yellow/white cantillation marks onto the physical Torah without projecting a distracting light box.

rules: Hebrew text MUST have proper RTL direction (`dir='rtl'`).
Line height for Hebrew must be generous (`leading-relaxed` or `leading-loose`) to accommodate te'amim (cantillation marks) above and below the letters.
Never use decorative English fonts for functional status labels.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous and uncluttered. The layout must allow the chanter to focus strictly on the text without visual noise.
spacing_and_layout.phone_grid: Bento-style for setup, switching to a focused vertical stack for the reading session.
spacing_and_layout.projector_grid: Absolute positioning based on affine transform coordinates. No standard grids.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Use `p-6` or `p-8` for status cards. The active line view needs `py-12` to stand out.

components.strategy: Shadcn/UI customized with classic borders (1px solid #E5E0D3) and zero shadow for a matte, paper-like feel.
components.status_indicators: Subtle pills. Green dot for 'Torah Detected', Amber for 'Searching...'
components.camera_viewfinder: Raw video feed layer with a digital reticle overlay (svg path, stroke-accent).
components.calibration_ui: 4-corner tap target UI layered over the camera. Draggable points using Framer Motion or native pointer events.
components.projector_output: Minimal unstyled route. Absolutely no chrome, nav, or borders. Pure black background.

rules: Zero distracting animations during the reading session.
Calibration points can have a subtle `pulse` to indicate interactivity.
Line transitions (advancing to next line) should use a very slow, smooth `transform: translateY` (0.5s ease-out) so the chanter's eye isn't jarred.

image_urls.usage: Use as a very low opacity background (e.g., `opacity-5` to `opacity-10`) layered via CSS blend modes on the setup/session screen to add an organic feel without compromising readability.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain strictly high contrast. Trope marks on projector must be pure yellow/white against pure black to ensure light maps properly onto physical parchment.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the app in two main contexts: 1) The Mobile PWA Setup/Reading Interface, 2) The Projector interface (`/projector`).
Ensure Shadcn components are modified to remove the default 'tech' glow and shadows. Use flat, warm tones for the mobile app.
For the Hebrew typography, ensure `Frank Ruhl Libre` is imported from Google Fonts. Include it in the tailwind config and use proper classes for Hebrew lines.
Implement the calibration UI using SVG overlays or absolute positioned divs that capture touch events for the 4 corners.
The `/projector` route must be pure black with zero UI padding or containers, as any non-black pixel will project visible light onto the physical Torah.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements such as buttons, toggles, and calibration nodes.
